column7: Logout (server/http/handlers/auth.go) blanket-mapped ANY error from core.Logout to 500 InternalError, including the ordinary case where the session was already deleted by a prior logout (a double-click, two tabs, or a client retry) -- confirmed live while building SESSION-N's N5 customer-journey test (real Keycloak OIDC login, then two logout calls with the same session cookie): the second call returned 500. Fixed by core.ErrSessionNotFound + errors.Is in the handler, returning 401 (an ordinary auth outcome) instead; TestLogout_InvalidToken_S8 tightened from accepting either 200 or 500 to asserting the now-deterministic 401. Logout has exactly one caller in this repo. See scripts/e2e/journeys/journey5_sso_login_test.go for the live end-to-end reproduction/regression.
